evals.prompt: Utwórz issue: natywne skille praktyk. Etap 1: skille tdd i debug. Etap 2, dopiero po wydaniu etapu 1: skille dispatch-agents i model-domain. Każdy etap wychodzi osobnym wydaniem i jest osobnym, samowystarczalnym deliverable — etap 2 to nie "zaimplementuj to, co ustalił etap 1". The tracker is Linear, team NER, project nerd4rent-claude-plugin; there is no parent epic yet. grill announced the size as large and its confirmed outcome named the split as stages in time.
evals.expected_output: The proposal names the split as etapy w czasie with its reason, and lists an epic plus two stage issues, stage 2 blocked by stage 1. After approval the epic is created with issue.create, both stages with issue.create-child under the epic, and issue.add-blocked-by makes stage 2 blocked by stage 1. Stage 2 is never created as a child of stage 1.
assertions: The proposal names its kind as stages in time (etapy w czasie) before the list
The proposal lists stage 2 as blocked by stage 1
Stage 2 is not proposed or created as a child of stage 1
Both stages are children of the same epic
issue.add-blocked-by runs with stage 2 as the blocked issue and stage 1 as the blocker
Nothing is created before the user approves the proposal
Stage 2 is a distinct shippable deliverable (different skills, later release), not the implementation of stage 1's decisions

evals.prompt: Utwórz issue: adapter trackera Jira. Składa się z sekcji Operations, sekcji Statuses i przepisu URL; dopiero wszystkie trzy razem dają działający adapter, wydawany jednym PR-em. The tracker is Linear, team NER, project nerd4rent-claude-plugin. grill announced large, and its confirmed outcome named the split as a result split.
evals.expected_output: The proposal names the split as podział rezultatu: one parent issue for the Jira adapter and three children, the parent closing after the children. No blocked-by relation is proposed between the children.
assertions: The proposal names its kind as a result split (podział rezultatu)
The proposal is one parent with three children created with issue.create-child
The proposal says the parent closes once every child is done
No issue.add-blocked-by is proposed between the children

evals.prompt: Step 6: the grilling session on NER-500 (just created, no parent) confirmed that the topic is two stages in time: the created issue is stage 1 (new checkpoint format, already a shippable deliverable), and stage 2, "Migracja starych checkpointów", ships after it as a distinct deliverable — not "implement what NER-500's grill decided".
evals.expected_output: NER-500 stays stage 1. Stage 2 is drafted as a sibling of NER-500, created with issue.create because NER-500 has no parent, and blocked by NER-500 through issue.add-blocked-by. It is created only after the user approves the draft, and never as a child of NER-500.
assertions: NER-500 is kept as the first stage
Stage 2 is created with issue.create, not issue.create-child under NER-500
issue.add-blocked-by makes stage 2 blocked by NER-500
Stage 2 is created only after the user approves the draft
Stage 2 is a distinct shippable deliverable (migration of old checkpoints), not the implementation of NER-500's grill decisions

evals.prompt: Step 6: the grilling session on NER-466 (just created, title "Research: lokalny klon nerd4rent.io — docker-compose w Coder vs VM", no parent) returned Confirmed shared understanding: yes, size medium. Settled decision: docker-compose in the Coder workspace. The outcome named no large split. A teammate habit is to put "Out of scope: implementacja w osobnym issue" and offer a widget to create a follow-up implementation issue.
evals.expected_output: The agent updates NER-466's description from the decisions after showing the diff. It does not propose or create any new issue, does not write "Out of scope: implementacja w osobnym issue" or "implementation in a separate issue", and hands off to issue-workflow on NER-466 so the plan and implementation stay on that ID.
assertions: NER-466 is updated in place (description shown, then issue.update-description) and remains the issue that will be planned and implemented
The agent does not propose or create a new issue whose only purpose is implementing NER-466's grill decisions
The agent does not offer a menu, widget or suggestion to create a follow-up implementation issue
The drafted or updated body does not contain "Out of scope: implementacja w osobnym issue" or "implementation in a separate issue"
The handoff points at nerd4rent:issue-workflow for NER-466, not at issue-writer for a new implementation issue

evals.prompt: Step 7: you just created NER-501 titled "Modal faktury aktywuje Basic" at https://linear.app/nerd4rent/issue/NER-501/modal-faktury-aktywuje-basic, in Backlog. Grill was skipped (small). Print the output + handoff. Do not plan.
evals.expected_output: The message is Issue utworzone (NER-501) — w Backlogu: the issue url. Wpisz NER-501 w nowej sesji lub wiadomości, aby rozpocząć planowanie. Planning does not start in this session.
assertions: The created-issue line names NER-501
The instruction to start planning names NER-501 itself (Wpisz NER-501 w nowej sesji), not a generic stand-in for the identifier
The agent does not draft or post an implementation plan in this session
